groups.about: disease.disease_type lists every class a disease belongs to; G1a groups by a disease's main type and needs one type per row, G1b counts a disease under every type it has and needs the full list

G1a.question: For each main disease type, how many diseases are there, and how many of them are chronic and how many have a high mortality?
G1a.natural: SELECT disease_type, COUNT(*) AS diseases, SUM(CASE WHEN prognosis LIKE '%chronic%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chronic, SUM(CASE WHEN prognosis LIKE '%high_mortality%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_mortality FROM disease WHERE disease_type <> '' GROUP BY disease_type;
G1a.key: SELECT disease_type, COUNT(*) AS diseases, SUM(CASE WHEN prognosis LIKE '%chronic%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chronic, SUM(CASE WHEN prognosis LIKE '%high_mortality%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_mortality FROM (SELECT CASE disease_name WHEN 'Asthma' THEN 'allergic' WHEN 'Microcytic Anemia' THEN 'nutritional' WHEN 'Celiac Disease' THEN 'autoimmune' WHEN 'Chronic Fatigue Syndrome||myalgic encephalomyelitis' THEN 'idiopathic' WHEN 'Heart Failure' THEN 'vascular' WHEN 'Acne' THEN 'inflammatory' WHEN 'Immune Reconstitution Syndrome (IRS)' THEN 'inflammatory' ELSE TRIM(CASE WHEN instr(disease_type, '||') > 0 THEN substr(disease_type, 1, instr(disease_type, '||') - 1) ELSE disease_type END) END AS disease_type, prognosis FROM disease WHERE disease_type <> '') GROUP BY disease_type;

G1b.question: How many diseases are classified as inflammatory, as infectious, as vascular, as degenerative and as psychiatric?
G1b.natural: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN disease_type LIKE '%inflammatory%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inflammatory, SUM(CASE WHEN disease_type LIKE '%infectious%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS infectious, SUM(CASE WHEN disease_type LIKE '%vascular%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vascular, SUM(CASE WHEN disease_type LIKE '%degenerative%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS degenerative, SUM(CASE WHEN disease_type LIKE '%psychiatric%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS psychiatric FROM disease;
G1b.key: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN disease_type LIKE '%inflammatory%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inflammatory, SUM(CASE WHEN disease_type LIKE '%infectious%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS infectious, SUM(CASE WHEN disease_type LIKE '%vascular%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vascular, SUM(CASE WHEN disease_type LIKE '%degenerative%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS degenerative, SUM(CASE WHEN disease_type LIKE '%psychiatric%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS psychiatric FROM disease;

groups.about: disease.treatments lists each treatment modality as stated (oral_medication, injection, surgery, dietary_intervention, ...); G2a needs the kinds of treatment (medication, procedure, lifestyle), G2b the stated modalities

G2a.question: For chronic and other diseases, how many are treated with medication of any kind, how many with surgery or another procedure, and how many with lifestyle or diet changes?
G2a.natural: SELECT CASE WHEN prognosis LIKE '%chronic%' THEN 'chronic' ELSE 'other' END AS course, COUNT(*) AS diseases, SUM(CASE WHEN treatments LIKE '%medication%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medication, SUM(CASE WHEN treatments LIKE '%procedure%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS procedure, SUM(CASE WHEN treatments LIKE '%lifestyle%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lifestyle FROM disease WHERE treatments <> '' GROUP BY course;
G2a.key: SELECT CASE WHEN prognosis LIKE '%chronic%' THEN 'chronic' ELSE 'other' END AS course, COUNT(*) AS diseases, SUM(CASE WHEN treatments LIKE '%medication%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medication, SUM(CASE WHEN treatments LIKE '%procedure%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS procedure, SUM(CASE WHEN treatments LIKE '%lifestyle%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lifestyle FROM (SELECT prognosis, CASE treatments WHEN 'oral_medication||injection' THEN 'medication' WHEN 'oral_medication||lifestyle_modification||dietary_intervention||regular_exercise' THEN 'medication||lifestyle' WHEN 'oral_medication||other' THEN 'medication||other' WHEN 'oral_medication||dietary_intervention' THEN 'medication||lifestyle' WHEN 'injection||dietary_intervention||lifestyle_modification' THEN 'medication||lifestyle' WHEN 'oral_medication||surgery' THEN 'medication||procedure' WHEN 'oral_medication||lifestyle_modification||dietary_intervention' THEN 'medication||lifestyle' WHEN 'chemotherapy||radiotherapy||surgery' THEN 'medication||procedure' WHEN 'chemotherapy||stem cell transplantation' THEN 'medication||procedure' WHEN 'physical_therapy||injection||oral_medication||device_implantation' THEN 'medication||procedure||physical or psychological therapy' WHEN 'lifestyle_modification||oral_medication||dietary_intervention' THEN 'medication||lifestyle' WHEN 'oral_medication' THEN 'medication' WHEN 'injection' THEN 'medication' WHEN 'oral_medication||inhaler||dietary_intervention' THEN 'medication||lifestyle' WHEN 'dietary_intervention' THEN 'lifestyle' WHEN 'oral_medication||psychotherapy||lifestyle_modification' THEN 'medication||lifestyle||physical or psychological therapy' WHEN 'oral_medication||injection||surgery||dietary_intervention||others' THEN 'medication||procedure||lifestyle||other' WHEN 'surgery||drug_therapy||lifestyle_modification||others' THEN 'medication||procedure||lifestyle||other' WHEN 'surgery||hormone_therapy||chemotherapy' THEN 'medication||procedure' WHEN 'oral_medication||lifestyle_modification||surgery' THEN 'medication||procedure||lifestyle' WHEN 'physical_therapy||oral_medication||surgery' THEN 'medication||procedure||physical or psychological therapy' WHEN 'oral_medication||lifestyle_modification||others' THEN 'medication||lifestyle||other' WHEN 'oral_medication||others' THEN 'medication||other' WHEN 'injection||oral_medication' THEN 'medication' WHEN 'psychotherapy' THEN 'physical or psychological therapy' WHEN 'surgery' THEN 'procedure' WHEN 'vaccination||oral_medication' THEN 'medication' WHEN 'injection||laboratory_test||dietary_intervention||lifestyle_modification' THEN 'medication||lifestyle||other' WHEN 'oral_medication||lifestyle_modification||dietary_intervention||others' THEN 'medication||lifestyle||other' WHEN 'oral_medication||physical_therapy||lifestyle_modification||surgery||injection||dietary_intervention' THEN 'medication||procedure||lifestyle||physical or psychological therapy' WHEN 'oral_medication||lifestyle_modification' THEN 'medication||lifestyle' WHEN 'surgery||oral_medication' THEN 'medication||procedure' WHEN 'oral_medication||surgery||physical_therapy||psychotherapy||others' THEN 'medication||procedure||physical or psychological therapy||other' WHEN 'psychotherapy||physical_therapy||lifestyle_modification' THEN 'lifestyle||physical or psychological therapy' WHEN 'oral_medication||psychotherapy||lifestyle_modification||dietary_intervention||regular_exercise||relaxation_techniques||meditation' THEN 'medication||lifestyle||physical or psychological therapy' WHEN 'surgery||radiotherapy||chemotherapy||biological_therapy||dietary_intervention' THEN 'medication||procedure||lifestyle' WHEN 'oral_medication||injection||surgery||lifestyle_modification||dietary_intervention||physical_therapy' THEN 'medication||procedure||lifestyle||physical or psychological therapy' WHEN 'oral_medication||chemotherapy||lifestyle_modification' THEN 'medication||lifestyle' WHEN 'physical_therapy||surgery||lifestyle_modification||others' THEN 'procedure||lifestyle||physical or psychological therapy||other' WHEN 'dietary_intervention||oral_medication' THEN 'medication||lifestyle' WHEN 'oral_medication||physical_therapy' THEN 'medication||physical or psychological therapy' WHEN 'chemotherapy' THEN 'medication' WHEN 'psychotherapy||oral_medication' THEN 'medication||physical or psychological therapy' WHEN 'lifestyle_modification||oral_medication||surgery||others' THEN 'medication||procedure||lifestyle||other' WHEN 'oral_medication||injection||surgery' THEN 'medication||procedure' WHEN 'oral_medication||injection||lifestyle_modification||dietary_intervention' THEN 'medication||lifestyle' WHEN 'injection||oral_medication||dietary_intervention||lifestyle_modification||surgery' THEN 'medication||procedure||lifestyle' WHEN 'physical_therapy||lifestyle_modification||dietary_intervention||oral_medication' THEN 'medication||lifestyle||physical or psychological therapy' WHEN 'injection||chemotherapy||immunotherapy' THEN 'medication' WHEN 'lifestyle_modification||dietary_intervention' THEN 'lifestyle' ELSE treatments END AS treatments FROM disease WHERE treatments <> '') GROUP BY course;

G2b.question: How many diseases are treated with surgery, with injections, with lifestyle changes, with a diet, and with physical therapy?
G2b.natural: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN treatments LIKE '%surgery%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS surgery, SUM(CASE WHEN treatments LIKE '%injection%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS injection, SUM(CASE WHEN treatments LIKE '%lifestyle_modification%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lifestyle_modification, SUM(CASE WHEN treatments LIKE '%dietary_intervention%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dietary_intervention, SUM(CASE WHEN treatments LIKE '%physical_therapy%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS physical_therapy FROM disease;
G2b.key: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN treatments LIKE '%surgery%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS surgery, SUM(CASE WHEN treatments LIKE '%injection%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS injection, SUM(CASE WHEN treatments LIKE '%lifestyle_modification%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lifestyle_modification, SUM(CASE WHEN treatments LIKE '%dietary_intervention%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dietary_intervention, SUM(CASE WHEN treatments LIKE '%physical_therapy%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS physical_therapy FROM disease;

groups.about: drug.disease_name lists the conditions a label treats as the label words them; G3a joins the disease table and needs each drug's main condition stored in the disease table's spelling, G3b needs every stated condition

G3a.question: For each disease the collection describes, how many drug labels are mainly for it, and how many of those need a prescription?
G3a.natural: SELECT disease.disease_name, COUNT(*) AS drugs, SUM(CASE WHEN drug.prescription_status = 'prescription_only' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prescription_only FROM drug JOIN disease ON drug.disease_name = disease.disease_name GROUP BY disease.disease_name;
G3a.key: SELECT disease.disease_name, COUNT(*) AS drugs, SUM(CASE WHEN drug.prescription_status = 'prescription_only' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prescription_only FROM drug JOIN disease ON disease.disease_name = CASE drug.disease_name WHEN 'Major depressive disorder||Cancer-related anxiety||Cancer-related depression||Eating disorders||Headaches||Substance abuse||Alcohol abuse||Opioid abuse||Smoking||Cocaine abuse' THEN 'Major Depressive Disorder' WHEN 'Gastroesophageal reflux disease||Peptic ulcer disease' THEN 'Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease||GERD' WHEN 'Gastroesophageal reflux disease||Gastric acid-related disorders' THEN 'Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease||GERD' WHEN 'Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease||Esophagitis||Zollinger-Ellison Syndrome||Multiple Endocrine Adenomas' THEN 'Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease||GERD' WHEN 'Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder||High Blood Pressure' THEN 'Attention-Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder' WHEN 'Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder' THEN 'Attention-Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder' WHEN 'ADHD||attention deficit disorder||narcolepsy||depression||obesity' THEN 'Attention-Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder' WHEN 'Irritable Bowel Syndrome with Constipation||Chronic Idiopathic Constipation||Functional Constipation' THEN 'Irritable Bowel Syndrome' WHEN 'Post transplantation diabetes mellitus||Impaired glucose tolerance||Diabetes Mellitus' THEN 'Diabetes Mellitus' WHEN 'Diabetes||Heart Disease||Urinary Tract Infections||Gastric Ulcers||Candida Infection||Dengue Fever' THEN 'Diabetes Mellitus' WHEN 'Type 2 Diabetes' THEN 'Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus' WHEN 'Hypertension||Heart Diseases||Kidney Failure||Liver Failure' THEN 'Hypertension' WHEN 'Hypertension||Chronic kidney disease||Severe congestive heart failure||Volume depletion' THEN 'Hypertension' WHEN 'Periodontal disease' THEN 'Periodontal Disease' WHEN 'Depression||Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder||Panic Disorder||Bulimia Nervosa' THEN 'Depression' WHEN 'treatment-resistant depression' THEN 'Major Depressive Disorder' WHEN 'severe eosinophilic asthma||eosinophilic granulomatosis with polyangiitis||chronic obstructive pulmonary disease' THEN 'Asthma' WHEN 'Herpes labialis||Herpes simplex' THEN 'Herpes Simplex Virus Infection||cold sores||genital herpes' WHEN 'Herpes simplex||Genital herpes||Shingles||Chicken pox||Cold sores||Epstein-Barr virus infection' THEN 'Herpes Simplex Virus Infection||cold sores||genital herpes' WHEN 'osteoarthritis||rheumatoid arthritis||gout||ankylosing spondylitis||tendinitis||bursitis' THEN 'Osteoarthritis' WHEN 'Generalized Anxiety Disorder||Panic Disorder' THEN 'Anxiety Disorders' WHEN 'Alcohol withdrawal||Anxiety disorders||Muscle spasms||Stiffness||Seizures||Panic attacks||Vertigo||Insomnia' THEN 'Anxiety Disorders' WHEN 'Human immunodeficiency virus infection||diabetes mellitus||gastrointestinal disorders||peptic ulcers||tuberculosis||Mycobacteria kansasii infection||Mycobacteria xenopi infection' THEN 'Tuberculosis' WHEN 'Metastatic Colorectal Cancer||Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumour' THEN 'Metastatic Colorectal Cancer||mCRC' WHEN 'HIV infection||AIDS' THEN 'HIV-1 Infection' WHEN 'acute graft-vs-host disease' THEN 'Acute Graft-Versus-Host Disease' WHEN 'Cystic fibrosis' THEN 'Cystic Fibrosis' WHEN 'cancer' THEN 'Cancer' ELSE drug.disease_name END GROUP BY disease.disease_name;

G3b.question: How many drug labels list panic, an ulcer, gout, diabetes and heart failure among the conditions they treat?
G3b.natural: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN disease_name LIKE '%panic%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS panic, SUM(CASE WHEN disease_name LIKE '%ulcer%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ulcer, SUM(CASE WHEN disease_name LIKE '%gout%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gout, SUM(CASE WHEN disease_name LIKE '%diabetes%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diabetes, SUM(CASE WHEN disease_name LIKE '%heart failure%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS heart_failure FROM drug;
G3b.key: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN disease_name LIKE '%panic%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS panic, SUM(CASE WHEN disease_name LIKE '%ulcer%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ulcer, SUM(CASE WHEN disease_name LIKE '%gout%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gout, SUM(CASE WHEN disease_name LIKE '%diabetes%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diabetes, SUM(CASE WHEN disease_name LIKE '%heart failure%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS heart_failure FROM drug;

groups.about: drug.single_dose states population + dose pairs as text ('adults 10 mg || children 5 mg'); G5a needs the highest adult dose as a number of mg, G5b needs the stated text (weight-based doses)

G5a.question: How many drugs have a highest adult dose under 10 mg, from 10 to 99 mg, and 100 mg or more, and how many of each need a prescription?
G5a.natural: SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(single_dose AS REAL) < 10 THEN 'under 10 mg' WHEN CAST(single_dose AS REAL) < 100 THEN '10 to 99 mg' ELSE '100 mg or more' END AS dose_range, COUNT(*) AS drugs, SUM(CASE WHEN prescription_status = 'prescription_only' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prescription_only FROM drug WHERE single_dose IS NOT NULL GROUP BY dose_range;
G5a.key: SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(mg AS REAL) < 10 THEN 'under 10 mg' WHEN CAST(mg AS REAL) < 100 THEN '10 to 99 mg' ELSE '100 mg or more' END AS dose_range, COUNT(*) AS drugs, SUM(CASE WHEN prescription_status = 'prescription_only' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prescription_only FROM (SELECT CASE single_dose WHEN 'adults 25 milligrams' THEN 25 WHEN 'adults 400 mcg' THEN 0.4 WHEN 'adults 4 g piperacillin + 0.5 g tazobactam' THEN 4000 WHEN 'Esophageal-gastric varices bleeding 0.025 mg/hour intravenous infusion || Prevention of pancreatic complications 0.1 mg subcutaneous injection || Gastrointestinal pancreatic endocrine tumors 0.05 mg subcutaneous injection || Acromegaly 0.05~0.1 mg subcutaneous injection' THEN 0.1 WHEN 'adults 10-40 mg once a day||cardiovascular prevention 40 mg per day||post-transplant (immunosuppressive therapy) 20 mg per day (up to 40 mg)||renal or hepatic insufficiency 10 mg per day' THEN 40 WHEN 'adults 2 mg' THEN 2 WHEN 'adults 40 mg' THEN 40 WHEN 'adults 12.5 mg (Day 1)||adults 12.5 mg twice/d (for 2 days)||adults 25 mg twice/d (for 4 days)||adults 50 mg twice/d (for 7 days)||adults 100 mg twice/d (for 7 days)' THEN 100 WHEN 'adults 20 mg' THEN 20 WHEN 'adults 500 mg||children 12 mg per 2' THEN 500 WHEN 'adults 500mcg||adults 250mcg' THEN 0.5 WHEN 'adults 20 mg||pediatric patients 0.5 mg/kg/dose or 1 mg/kg/dose' THEN 20 WHEN 'adults 1 mg norethindrone acetate and 10 mcg ethinyl estradiol per tablet' THEN 1 WHEN 'adults 500 mg' THEN 500 WHEN 'adults 12.5 mg (Day 1)||adults 12.5 mg twice daily (for 2 days)||adults 25 mg twice daily (for 4 days)||adults 50 mg twice daily (for 7 days)||adults 100 mg twice daily (for 7 days)' THEN 100 WHEN 'adults 25 mg || elderly 30-50 mg || adolescents 30-50 mg' THEN 25 WHEN 'children and adolescents up to 54mg daily||adults up to 72mg daily' THEN 72 WHEN 'adults 250 mg || adults 500 mg || adults 750 mg || adults 1000 mg' THEN 1000 WHEN 'adults 600 mg' THEN 600 WHEN 'adults 1-2 tablets 500mg||adults 1 tablet 750mg||children 1 drop/kg (not exceeding 35 drops)||children see weight-based mL dosing' THEN 1000 WHEN 'adults 1 mg || adults 2 mg' THEN 2 WHEN '15 mg' THEN 15 WHEN 'adults 25-50 mg' THEN 50 WHEN 'adults sinusitis 500 mg||adults acute exacerbation of chronic bronchitis 250-500 mg||adults skin and soft tissue infections 250-500 mg||adults creatinine clearance 250 mg/24h||adults creatinine clearance 500 mg/24h||adults creatinine clearance 500 mg/12h||adults 50-20 mL/min 125-500 mg/24h||adults 19-10 mL/min 125-500 mg/24h||adults 10 mL/min 125-250 mg/24-48h' THEN 500 WHEN 'adults 5 mg||adults 10 mg||children over 6 years 2.5 mg||children over 6 years 5 mg' THEN 10 WHEN '125 to 250 mg || 250 to 500 mg' THEN 500 WHEN 'adults 400 mg' THEN 400 WHEN 'adults 10 mg || adults 25 mg' THEN 25 WHEN 'adults 30 mg 1-2 tablets || adults 60 mg 1 tablet' THEN 60 WHEN 'adults 160 mg' THEN 160 WHEN 'adults 300 mg' THEN 300 WHEN 'newborns 0.5 mg/kg/dose || pediatric patients <30 kg 1 mg/kg/dose || pediatric patients ≥30 kg adult dosage || adults ≥60 kg 20 mg || adults <60 kg 15 mg' THEN 20 WHEN 'adults and children 12 years old and older weighing 40 kg or more 1 tablet of 500 mg + 125 mg' THEN 500 WHEN 'adults 1 mg' THEN 1 WHEN 'adults and children over 12 years 200 mg each 8 hours up to 400 mg each 8-12 hours || children 6-12 years 200 mg each 8-12 hours up to 400 mg each 12 hours || adults and children over 12 years (prevention) 400 mg each 12 hours || children 6-12 years (prevention) 200-400 mg each 12 hours || adults and children over 12 years (hyperammonemia) 400 mg each 8 hours || children 6-12 years (hyperammonemia) 200-300 mg each 8 hours' THEN 400 WHEN 'most patients 5 mg || patients with severe renal impairment 2.5 mg || patients with moderate hepatic impairment 2.5 mg' THEN 5 WHEN 'adults 5 mg || adults 10 mg || adults 20 mg' THEN 20 WHEN 'adults 100 mg' THEN 100 WHEN 'adults 250-500mg||children 15mg/kg daily' THEN 500 WHEN '250 mg capsule||500 mg tablet||500 mg intravenous' THEN 500 WHEN 'oral 400mg||oral 800mg' THEN 800 WHEN 'adults 25 mg (oral capsule)||adults 1 mg (intravenous)||adults 10-20 mg (oral, equivalent to 1 mg IV)' THEN 25 WHEN 'patients with severe asthma aged 12 years and older 100 mg || adult patients with EGPA 3x100 mg' THEN 300 WHEN 'adults and adolescents (12 years and older) initial 400 mg (two 200 mg injections) || adults and adolescents (12 years and older) initial 600 mg (two 300 mg injections) || adults initial 600 mg (two 300 mg injections) || pediatric patients 15 to <30 kg 600 mg (two 300 mg injections) || pediatric patients 30 to <60 kg 400 mg (two 200 mg injections) || pediatric patients 60 kg or more 600 mg (two 300 mg injections)' THEN 600 ELSE NULL END AS mg, prescription_status FROM drug) WHERE mg IS NOT NULL GROUP BY dose_range;

G5b.question: For prescription-only drugs and the others, how many drug labels state a single dose, and how many of them give a dose per kilogram of body weight?
G5b.natural: SELECT CASE WHEN prescription_status = 'prescription_only' THEN 'prescription only' ELSE 'other' END AS status, COUNT(*) AS drugs, SUM(CASE WHEN single_dose LIKE '%/kg%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS per_kg FROM drug WHERE single_dose <> '' GROUP BY status;
G5b.key: SELECT CASE WHEN prescription_status = 'prescription_only' THEN 'prescription only' ELSE 'other' END AS status, COUNT(*) AS drugs, SUM(CASE WHEN single_dose LIKE '%/kg%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS per_kg FROM drug WHERE single_dose <> '' GROUP BY status;

groups.about: disease.affected_organs states organs and tissues as the source names them (brain, lungs, kidneys, ...); G7a needs the body systems they belong to, G7b the stated organs

G7a.question: For chronic and other diseases whose affected organs are known, how many affect the nervous system, the respiratory system, the cardiovascular system, the musculoskeletal system and the urinary system?
G7a.natural: SELECT CASE WHEN prognosis LIKE '%chronic%' THEN 'chronic' ELSE 'other' END AS course, COUNT(*) AS diseases, SUM(CASE WHEN affected_organs LIKE '%nervous system%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nervous_system, SUM(CASE WHEN affected_organs LIKE '%respiratory system%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS respiratory_system, SUM(CASE WHEN affected_organs LIKE '%cardiovascular system%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cardiovascular_system, SUM(CASE WHEN affected_organs LIKE '%musculoskeletal system%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS musculoskeletal_system, SUM(CASE WHEN affected_organs LIKE '%urinary system%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS urinary_system FROM disease WHERE affected_organs <> '' GROUP BY course;
G7a.key: SELECT CASE WHEN prognosis LIKE '%chronic%' THEN 'chronic' ELSE 'other' END AS course, COUNT(*) AS diseases, SUM(CASE WHEN affected_organs LIKE '%nervous system%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nervous_system, SUM(CASE WHEN affected_organs LIKE '%respiratory system%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS respiratory_system, SUM(CASE WHEN affected_organs LIKE '%cardiovascular system%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS WHEN 'gastrointestinal tract||rectosigmoid colon' THEN 'digestive system' WHEN 'large_blood_vessels||kidneys||eyes||nerves||pancreas' THEN 'nervous system||cardiovascular system||digestive 'skin||blood vessels||brain||cerebral white matter' THEN 'nervous system||cardiovascular system||skin' WHEN 'abdomen||liver||lung||digestive tract||skin' THEN 'respiratory system||digestive system||skin||other body parts' WHEN 'skin' THEN 'skin' WHEN 'facial skin||genital area' THEN 'skin||reproductive system' WHEN 'respiratory system' THEN 'respiratory system' WHEN 'lungs' THEN 'respiratory system' WHEN 'lungs||pancreas' THEN 'respiratory system||digestive system' WHEN 'gastrointestinal tract||intestine' THEN 'digestive system' WHEN 'joints||gums' THEN 'digestive 'heart||arteries||legs||lungs' THEN 'respiratory system||cardiovascular system||other body parts' WHEN 'urinary tract' THEN 'urinary system' WHEN 'prostate||kidney||bladder||liver||bone||lung||lymph_nodes' THEN 'respiratory system||digestive system||musculoskeletal system||urinary system||reproductive system||blood and immune system' WHEN 'esophagus' THEN 'digestive system' WHEN 'nerves||veins||shoulders||hands||arms' THEN 'nervous system||cardiovascular system||other body parts' WHEN 'skin||eyes' THEN 'skin||eyes and ears' WHEN 'ears' THEN 'eyes and ears' WHEN 'muscles||heart' THEN 'cardiovascular system||musculoskeletal system' WHEN 'brain' THEN 'nervous system' WHEN 'appendix' THEN 'digestive system' WHEN 'pancreas||kidney||eye||skin||heart' THEN 'cardiovascular system||digestive system||urinary system||skin||eyes and ears' WHEN 'large intestine||small intestine||colon' THEN 'digestive system' WHEN G7b.question: For chronic and other diseases whose affected organs are known, how many affect the brain, the heart, the lungs, the liver and the kidneys?
G7b.natural: SELECT CASE WHEN prognosis LIKE '%chronic%' THEN 'chronic' ELSE 'other' END AS course, SUM(CASE WHEN affected_organs LIKE '%brain%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS brain, SUM(CASE WHEN affected_organs LIKE '%heart%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS heart, SUM(CASE WHEN affected_organs LIKE '%lung%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lungs, SUM(CASE WHEN affected_organs LIKE '%liver%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS liver, SUM(CASE WHEN affected_organs LIKE '%kidney%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS kidneys FROM disease WHERE affected_organs <> '' GROUP BY course;
G7b.key: SELECT CASE WHEN prognosis LIKE '%chronic%' THEN 'chronic' ELSE 'other' END AS course, SUM(CASE WHEN affected_organs LIKE '%brain%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS brain, SUM(CASE WHEN affected_organs LIKE '%heart%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS heart, SUM(CASE WHEN affected_organs LIKE '%lung%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lungs, SUM(CASE WHEN affected_organs LIKE '%liver%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS liver, SUM(CASE WHEN affected_organs LIKE '%kidney%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS kidneys FROM disease WHERE affected_organs <> '' GROUP BY course;
